**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

AXXA now keeps the notes that went with each message, so the model sees them again on later turns, even after you reopen the chat. Long chats no longer get stuck at the model's limit, and requests are now built to use the provider's prompt cache, which makes the history you resend cheaper when you reply within a few minutes. You can also copy your own messages.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **The chat remembers its notes**: the notes found in your vault and the notes you attach now stay with the message they were sent with.
  - The model sees them again on later turns, not just once, until that part of the chat is summarized. In Agent mode, attached notes never reached the model before; now they do.
  - They are saved in the chat file, so a reopened chat remembers them too. That includes the text of notes, pasted text and web pages you attach, stored encoded (not encrypted) in a hidden comment in the file.
  - An agent run that hit an error after taking some actions is now kept, so the chat doesn't forget the notes it already created or edited.
  - Because the notes go with every later turn, a chat with long notes sends more tokens per turn than before. Prompt caching (below) makes that repeat cheap when you reply within a few minutes.
- **Long chats keep going**: when a chat nears the model's context window, its start is summarized by the same model.
  - The model then gets the summary plus the recent messages in full. You still see the whole chat, with a divider you can open to read the summary.
  - If a provider still refuses a request as too long, AXXA takes the real limit from the error when it states one, summarizes more of the chat (or, in the middle of an agent run, shortens older tool results) and tries again.
  - Before, a chat past the limit failed on every turn. Ollama, which doesn't warn, silently dropped the start of the chat.
- **Prompt caching**: the start of each request now stays the same turn after turn, so the provider can read it from its cache instead of processing it again. A cache read usually costs about a tenth of the normal input price.
  - Anthropic caches only when asked, and AXXA never asked. Now it does. The cache lasts 5 minutes from its last use, and writing to it costs 25% more than normal input. In a chat where you reply after longer pauses, each turn writes the cache again, so it can cost more than before, not less.
  - OpenAI and OpenRouter get a random key per chat, which helps each chat's requests reach the server that holds its cache.
  - Ollama: a shorter request between turns no longer changes the context size, which made Ollama reload the model and drop its cache.
- **A context meter**: a small ring next to the model name shows how much of the context window the chat uses. It turns orange (your theme's warning color) at 80%. The start is summarized as the chat nears the limit, which can happen before the ring gets there. Tap it for the details, including how much came from the cache.
- **Copy your messages**: a copy button under your own messages, and a Copy button under each answer. Text in the chat can now be selected.

### 🔧 Improvements
- **Usage counts the cache**: cached tokens are measured, priced at the cache rate, and Usage shows what the cache saved you. Prices for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini models (also through OpenRouter) were checked against their current lists, and some Gemini models now show a higher cost than before.
- **Ollama's model list** now follows what your Ollama has installed. It updates when you press Fetch models or Test in Settings, or change the address.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **Agent mode on GPT-5.4 and later** (OpenAI) works again. It failed on its first request. In Agent mode these models now answer without reasoning; Chat and Vault Q&A still use your Effort setting.
- **Gemini usage** is no longer counted several times per answer in a chat's totals. Chats saved before this update keep their old counts.
- **"Approve all"** given to an edit no longer approves web requests too.
- **Agent chat cards** show plain text instead of raw Markdown.

### ⚠️ Compatibility
- Reload Obsidian after updating. Settings migrate automatically. Chats saved before this version open as usual, but the notes that went with their earlier messages weren't saved, so the model won't see those again.
- Chats saved by this version still open in older versions, which ignore the saved context and summaries and remove them from the file if they save the chat again.
- Summarizing a long chat takes an extra request to the same model (more than one for a very long chat), counted in Usage and the daily spending limit like any other.
